title: Russo-Turkish War (1806–1812)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Russo-Turkish War (1806–1812)", at revision 1379751801, opens: "The Russo-Turkish War (1806–1812) was fought between the Russian Empire and the Ottoman Empire as one of 12 Russo-Turkish wars. In 1812, both sides favored peace just as Napoleon's invasion of Russia was about to commence." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q209312, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1806-12 conflict between the Russian and Ottoman Empires". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (named for this item in data/imports/wikidata-seeds.json): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
